title: Rosemary Beach "Slice of Heaven" 87 Bourne Lane
h1: Rosemary Beach "Slice of Heaven" 87 Bourne Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach - Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- Walking distance to Barrett Square- 5 adult bikes- Complimentary bottle of wine with each rental- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover a Slice of Heaven in beautiful Rosemary Beach—where laid-back 30A fun and elegant coastal living combine! Boasting an idyllic courtyard pool and relaxing indoor/outdoor spaces, this 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers a charming Emerald Coast retreat for groups or families of 12. Barrett Square is within walking distance of dining, shopping, and entertainment, and guests enjoy access to the fantastic community pools and walkovers to the Gulf’s tempting beaches—only a short stroll away.Exquisitely designed and decorated, this 3-story home’s serene setting begins with a lovely front porch furnished with woven chairs—a perfect spot to welcome the day. French doors open to a bright living space with exposed wood beams. Plush sofas and armchairs in soothing shades beckon for comfy gatherings before the TV or nights catching up with loved ones over the complimentary bottle of wine. Past the chic coffee bar beside the stairs, find a 6-person dining table, where guests can enjoy meals beneath the ambient glow of the coastal chandelier. The luxurious kitchen features premium appliances, quartzite countertops, and an expansive island that seats 6 for meals, quick bites, or planning the day's adventures. Guests will love spending idle days in the courtyard, complete with an inviting lounge pool, comfy seating, BBQ grill and patio table.Take the sunlit staircase to the second level, where a convenient desk and laundry closet await. Unwind for the night in the primary bedroom’s soft king bed, with a private bathroom and balcony adding to the restful atmosphere. The 2 guest bedrooms share a balcony and feature a queen bed and a king bed, respectively.On the third floor are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms—the first has 1 king bed and the other 4 twin beds.A Slice of Heaven has all guests need for a restorative Rosemary Beach getaway. On-site parking makes it easy to explore or take advantage of the 5 provided adult bikes to explore at a leisurely pace. The Cabana Pool and Coquina Pool are both a short walk, and the nearest beach access is only a 7-minute stroll at Walkover D, on East Water Street past Rosemary Avenue. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 4 Twin Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyIn addition, you also have access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.*Firepit is not for guest use.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and management fines.

Boasting an idyllic courtyard pool and relaxing indoor/outdoor spaces, this 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers a charming Emerald Coast retreat for groups or families of 12. Barrett Square is within walking distance of dining, shopping, and entertainment, and guests enjoy access to the fantastic community pools and walkovers to the Gulf’s tempting beaches—only a short stroll away. Exquisitely designed and decorated, this 3-story home’s serene setting begins with a lovely front porch furnished with woven chairs—a perfect spot to welcome the day. French doors open to a bright living space with exposed wood beams. Plush sofas and armchairs in soothing shades beckon for comfy gatherings before the TV or nights catching up with loved ones over the complimentary bottle of wine. Past the chic coffee bar beside the stairs, find a 6-person dining table, where guests can enjoy meals beneath the ambient glow of the coastal chandelier. The luxurious kitchen features premium appliances, quartzite countertops, and an expansive island that seats 6 for meals, quick bites, or planning the day's adventures. Guests will love spending idle days in the courtyard, complete with an inviting lounge pool, comfy seating, BBQ grill and patio table. Take the sunlit staircase to the second level, where a convenient desk and laundry closet await. Unwind for the night in the primary bedroom’s soft king bed, with a private bathroom and balcony adding to the restful atmosphere. The 2 guest bedrooms share a balcony and feature a queen bed and a king bed, respectively. On the third floor are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms—the first has 1 king bed and the other 4 twin beds. A Slice of Heaven has all guests need for a restorative Rosemary Beach getaway. On-site parking makes it easy to explore or take advantage of the 5 provided adult bikes to explore at a leisurely pace. The Cabana Pool and Coquina Pool are both a short walk, and the nearest beach access is only a 7-minute stroll at Walkover D, on East Water Street past Rosemary Avenue. Book today!
